notes: Conformance fixtures for scripts/skill-conformance.test.ts: shaped fake values only, never a real endpoint or a real identity. One scenario is enough — the skill has no when: guards and no branching prompts, so a single install path covers every directive. The exec stubs answer the wiring scripts, the module refresh, the build, the two test runs and the restart; none of them reads stdout, so an empty one is the honest stub. The bearer token is deliberately absent: it is an nc:operator step, never an input.
